sn35.64:1.1: atha kho āyasmā migajālo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn35.64:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā migajālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.64:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.64:2.1: santi kho migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.64:2.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.64:2.3: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
sn35.64:2.6: santi kho migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.64:2.7: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.64:2.8: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
sn35.64:3.1: santi kho migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.64:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati
sn35.64:3.5: santi kho migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaññahitā rajaniyā
sn35.64:3.6: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati anajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati
sn35.64:4.1: atha kho āyasmā migajālo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn35.64:4.2: atha kho āyasmā migajālo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā samma deva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
sn35.64:4.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn35.64:4.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā migajālo arahataṃ ahosīti.
